About

World and event-region maxima are separate metrics. Event-region population is determined by the event's assigned regionCode, not team home state. Frozen source retrieval; values retain source precision in JSON/CSV.

FTC (FIRST Tech Challenge) uses smaller robots than FRC and its own game; OPR ratings aren’t comparable to FRC’s EPA.
